title: Add type stubs for google libraries instead of ignoring imports
description: PR #940 added a per-module mypy override to ignore missing imports for google_auth_oauthlib.* and googleapiclient.* because they lack py.typed markers. Instead of suppressing the errors, we should add proper type stubs (e.g. types-google-api-python-client, types-google-auth-oauthlib if they exist, or write minimal local stubs). This would let mypy actually check the google API calls in scripts/upload_youtube.py rather than treating them as Any.
